# Ralf

> Ralf is an agentic SEO and AI-search platform. It measures whether leading AI answer engines name or cite a business, then helps improve that visibility through technical fixes, a controlled content programme and citation-focused outreach.

## Products
- Search — tracks brand mentions and citations across leading AI answer engines, crawls a site for technical SEO issues and prioritises the work.
- Content — plans, writes, quality-checks and publishes new articles and updates to supported CMSs.
- Outreach — finds relevant citation and link opportunities, drafts personalised outreach and can manage sending when the required sending account is connected.
- Suite — combines Search, Content and Outreach.

## Ralf Content
- Automatic content types can include guides, how-tos, best-of listicles, comparisons, approved competitor alternatives, use-case pages, industry pages, integration pages, and pricing or evaluation pages.
- Users can switch automatic content types on or off. Choices apply to future new articles; existing and planned work is not deleted, and published pages can still be updated.
- The Content view shows the number of articles in each type, split by live, planned, writing and updating status.
- Competitor-alternative articles are selected from the user's approved competitor list, not inferred from an unrelated keyword.
- Case studies, original research and first-hand reviews require verified, permissioned evidence or a real dataset. Ralf does not autonomously invent or publish them without that evidence.
- Formats are matched to the buyer question and the evidence needed to answer it. No content format guarantees a ranking or citation.

## Pricing (USD / month, billed monthly)
- Search — $49 Starter, $149 Growth, $299 Pro, or Agency from $799.
- Content — $39 Starter, $89 Growth, $199 Pro, or $399 Scale.
- Outreach — $49 Starter, $119 Growth, $249 Pro, or $499 Scale.
- Suite — $137 Starter, $357 Growth, $747 Pro, or Scale from $1,697.
